text: Artificial intelligence is rapidly changing how we work. One of its main benefits is automation, which handles repetitive tasks like data entry or scheduling, freeing employees to focus on more creative work. Many companies also use AI-powered productivity tools, such as smart email filters and meeting summarizers, to save time daily. However, AI is not replacing humans entirely. The key is human-AI collaboration, where machines analyze large amounts of information and people make final decisions. This means some jobs will change, requiring new skills like asking the right questions and checking AI results. Workers who adapt will find their roles more interesting, not less.
